cv.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
summary: Senior analytics professional with experience across analytics engineering, business intelligence, and growth analytics. Strong background in SQL data modeling, Python automation, and behavioral analysis, with hands-on delivery of reliable data pipelines, business metrics, and analytics tools for product and commercial decisions.

bullets: Own and build end-to-end data pipelines from source ingestion through Snowflake transformations to consumption in GoodData and downstream reporting.
Develop reusable SQL data models across landing, intermediate, and aggregated layers, centralizing business logic, definitions, and metrics for downstream reporting.
Maintain Apache Airflow DAGs and version-controlled data pipelines in GitLab CI, using Cursor and custom skills to support continuous documentation.
Contribute to a YAML-driven data quality framework covering approximately 80 Snowflake tables, owning validation checks for funnels, sales channels, and dimension tables.
Developing a Snowflake MCP integration to enable LLM-driven analytical SQL execution, defining semantic context and metric definitions for core warehouse tables.
Developing an in-house dashboarding solution using Claude to deliver accessible self-service insights directly from warehouse data models.

projects.name: Traffic Source & Customer Journey Attribution
bullets: Designed incremental event- and journey-grain enrichment pipelines for traffic source, integration type, and first-touch attribution context.
Implemented safe rollout across intermediate and aggregated layers with controlled backfills and parallel testing, preserving existing reporting consistency.
Delivered attribution dashboards and business logic across 72 customer brands, adopted by all customer success managers to guide client setup decisions.
Designed and maintained the analytics stack, production data models, and dashboards supporting €200k–€500k in monthly marketing spend across 51 cities.
Partnered directly with marketing leadership to translate budget scenarios into expected ROAS, CAC, and subscriber growth outcomes.

projects.name: Demand Forecasting Models & Scenario Dashboard
bullets: Built scalable demand forecasting data models using dbt and Snowflake, replacing manual spreadsheets and improving planning accuracy by ~20%.
Delivered scenario-planning dashboards that directed monthly spend to high-ROI segments, contributing to an 8–10% ROAS uplift and 3–5% CAC reductions.
Co-built data pipelines from scratch in BigQuery and dbt, unifying behavioral event tracking, marketing sources, and transactional data for multi-million-euro investment volumes.
Eliminated manual reporting workflows through automation, saving approximately 10 hours per week and improving decision turnaround time.
Developed a Python workflow for voucher and cashback calculations and SEPA-compatible payment files, integrating it into dbt and Y42 pipelines for reproducibility.

projects.name: Behavioral Attribution Modeling & Spend Reallocation
bullets: Engineered a Markov chain attribution model integrating paid, CRM, and offline touchpoints, reducing blended CAC by 8% and improving conversion rates by ~5%.

projects.name: Conversational SQL Analytics Tool
bullets: Built a conversational analytics interface using OpenAI's API to translate business questions into BigQuery SQL, enabling self-service metrics access.
Delivered cross-functional analytics across marketing, product, and sales, maintaining executive KPI dashboards in Looker.
Supported product experimentation and A/B testing on automotive marketplace search features, optimizing funnel progression and conversion rates.

projects.name: Multi-Touch Attribution & Behavioral Pipeline
bullets: Built a custom multi-touch attribution model using session-level behavioral data and Matillion ETL, driving 6–8% more qualified leads and a ~4% conversion lift.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Analytics Engineer position in the Netherlands advertised through Jobgether on behalf of your company. My experience spans analytics engineering, business intelligence, and growth analytics, with a focus on translating business questions into reliable data models and useful reporting. The role’s emphasis on behavioral data, meaningful metrics, and end-to-end ownership aligns closely with my work. I value close collaboration between technical and business teams.

At Aklamio, I own ETL pipelines from ingestion through Snowflake transformations to GoodData reporting, developing reusable SQL models and maintaining Airflow orchestration and GitLab workflows. I contribute to a data quality framework covering approximately 80 tables, owning funnel and sales-channel checks that validate business logic and reconcile derived values. I also led a traffic-source and customer-journey attribution initiative, delivering incremental enrichment pipelines and dashboards. Analysis across 72 brands is now used by all customer success managers to recommend improvements to client channel setups.

Previously, at NeoTaste, I built Snowflake and dbt models for demand forecasting across 51 cities, improving planning accuracy by approximately 20% and supporting budget decisions through scenario dashboards. At ecoligo, I helped build the data pipeline from scratch using BigQuery and dbt, combining behavioral, marketing, and investment data. I developed Python payment automation and an OpenAI-powered SQL interface for self-service analytics. At heycar, I supported experimentation on marketplace and search features and maintained Looker dashboards, linking customer behavior to conversion and commercial performance.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute my SQL, Python, data modeling, and stakeholder experience to your analytics team. I hold a valid EU Blue Card issued by Germany and would require employer support for the appropriate work authorization in the Netherlands. I look forward to discussing how I can help deliver trustworthy data products for your teams and customers.
